D13-WIN-BLOCKERS.detail: (1) Fixed on every pane exit path. claudeteam.ps1:122-206 wraps the whole pane body in try { ... } finally { if ($null -ne $paneRow) { Remove-ClaudeTeamPidFile -Session $paneRow.Session } }. The body is either Invoke-ClaudeTeamRemoteLoop or the local restore/provision/`& claude` sequence. The finally therefore runs when the loop returns early (ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:1750-1762: missing python, missing ssh.exe or an empty secret), on Ctrl-C (about_Try_Catch_Finally: finally runs on CTRL+C) and on terminating errors (ErrorActionPreference Stop). Remove-ClaudeTeamPidFile (:346-359) deletes the file only when it still holds $PID. The pane shell that ran Initialize-ClaudeTeamPane (:1682) is the same process, so the file is removed. A file that a rerun already rewrote is kept. Once the file is gone, Get-ClaudeTeamLivePid (:425-437) counts only a claude.exe/node.exe --name match. The idle -NoExit powershell.exe is therefore not live, so the scratch-PID-file verify holds, checked statically. try does not create a new scope, so the dot-sourced helpers stay script-scoped. Remove-ClaudeTeamPidFile appears once in claudeteam.ps1 (:204). The separate call after `& claude` is gone. The standalone branch (paneRow $null) is unchanged: no PID file, `exit $exitCode`. Linux parity: claudeteam.sh:140-141 exits the remote pane after the loop and :198 execs claude, so no Linux change is needed. (2)-(6) are unchanged since round 1 and re-read. (2) Set-ClaudeTeamSessionEnvironment :1725-1730 clears every session_env.lead key for non-lead rows. (3) Get-ClaudeTeamStandaloneRow :1693-1707 and claudeteam.ps1:156-169 apply the role spec. (4) Get-ClaudeTeamNamedProcessMap :1379-1381 filters on SessionId. (5) Select-ClaudeTeamGrid :957-985 uses max area (paneCols*paneRows, ties keep fewer columns), with column fill in Set-ClaudeTeamTabLayout. The round-1 hand check stands: on 2560x1600@96 with 15 roles, max area gives 3 columns and the old aspect-2.5 rule gave 4. (6) $teammateMode has 0 hits in the launcher files. $ClaudeTeamLeadTeammateMode is declared once (ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:60). $ClaudeTeamInstallCatalogPath (:24) and $ClaudeTeamInstallUserClaudeDir (:38) are declared once, in ClaudeTeamInstallCommon.ps1.
